Market today: The mood is cautious in tech, driven by company-specific guidance. Negative news from Reddit, Amazon, and especially Intel is weighing on sentiment, despite some positive chip news from Sandisk. This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.44%), MUU (-27.45%), and SMCI (-21.54%) are deeply underwater. Remember, you're on margin, and these leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU) amplify losses and decay over time, making these drawdowns extra painful.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Intel's continued weakness, as it could drag down your other chip holdings. Also, monitor your existing SNOW position, as the scanner shows a potential long setup around 325.87-325.09.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply negative, leveraged chip positions in light of sector-specific headwinds.
plays: SOXL is down over 50% and leveraged. Given Intel's weakness, consider trimming or re-evaluating its stop to protect capital.
MUU, another leveraged chip ETF, is down significantly. Watch its stop at 31.6 closely; sector weakness could trigger it.
SMCI is down over 20%. Keep a tight eye on its stop at 37.3, as broader chip sector weakness could push it lower.
